[[Istani Cultist]]s look like normal Istani citizens; however, they are only seen bowing and praying to some [[Skale]]. From this it seems that the Istani Cultists believe that the Skales are holy creatures.

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Power Attack}}

==Notes==
*When not in [[aggro]] range they stand still doing various [[emote]]s. These include /dance (male ranger or female elementalist versions) and /kneel.
*They are considered a separate group from the Skale, and thus will not be aggroed if the Skale are aggroed.

==Trivia==
*Unlike most enemies, the Istani Cultist comes in two visual versions, male and female.
